name: night-at-sea
about: A clear night on open water, read by the steersman: the sea kit (film-readymades/odyssey-sea.js) as look.sea under a cool key with a moon. Scenes take it as their key's look and add their own beats (constellations, gusts, holds, a break).
lights: the kit's own: a cool moon light (#9fb8ff) and a blue hemisphere fill at night, the key's sun dimmed by night; lanterns (warm, flickering on twos) on a ship when lanterns is not false

palette.faces: #1A4A8C, Blue #1E5AA8, Medium Blue #7396C8, Bright Light Blue #9DC3F7
palette.stars: Trans-Clear, Trans-Yellow, Trans-Light-Blue round plates 1x1; constellations at 2x2 size
